name: Intel Core i7-13700K
description: High performance 13th Gen desktop processor with hybrid performance and efficient cores architecture.
whyItMatters: The CPU is the central brain executing logic and instructions. The socket type determines which motherboards are physically compatible.

name: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D
description: Zen 4 architecture processor with 3D V-Cache technology tailored for high-speed computation and low latency gaming.
whyItMatters: AM5 is a Land Grid Array socket that requires DDR5 memory and an AM5-compatible cooler bracket.

name: ASUS Prime Z790-P WiFi
description: Full ATX LGA1700 motherboard designed for Intel 12th/13th/14th Gen processors with DDR5 memory support.
whyItMatters: The motherboard interconnects all system components, hosts power delivery circuitry (VRMs), and dictates slot expansion capabilities.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB 32GB (2x16GB) DDR5-6000
description: Dual-channel high-speed DDR5 memory kit with aluminium heat spreaders.
whyItMatters: RAM holds active volatile data for instantaneous CPU access. Dual-channel configurations double bandwidth when installed in designated slots (A2/B2).

name: Samsung 980 Pro 1TB NVMe M.2 SSD
description: High performance NVMe solid state drive directly connecting to motherboard PCIe lanes.
whyItMatters: NVMe SSDs provide non-volatile storage with vastly higher IOPS and throughput than legacy spinning hard drives.

name: Corsair RM850x 850W 80+ Gold Fully Modular
description: Fully modular power supply delivering clean continuous power with low electrical ripple and high efficiency.
whyItMatters: Converts wall AC electricity to DC voltages (12V, 5V, 3.3V). Inadequate wattage or unstable ripple causes sudden shutdowns and data corruption.

name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 12GB
description: Ada Lovelace architecture graphics processor with dedicated ray-tracing and tensor computing cores.
whyItMatters: Renders visual frames and executes massive parallel matrix operations. Requires dedicated PCIe slot and supplemental PSU power cable.

name: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE
description: Dual-tower 6-heatpipe air cooler with dual 120mm PWM fans.
whyItMatters: Removes concentrated thermal energy from the CPU die to prevent catastrophic overheating and thermal throttling.

name: Arctic MX-4 (4g)
description: High performance carbon micro-particle thermal compound.
whyItMatters: Fills microscopic air voids between the CPU integrated heat spreader and cooler baseplate.

name: Fractal Design Pop Air RGB
description: Mid-tower ATX enclosure with high airflow mesh front panel and tempered glass side panel.
whyItMatters: Chassis houses, grounds, protects, and directs convective airflow over all internal computer components.
